title: Get Funded! — UI explorations
mode: Built-in image_gen; preview-only, existing game UI untouched

themes.name: 01 / TOY BOX
themes.fonts: Fredoka heading; Nunito Sans body and tabular numbers
themes.design: Rounded chunky panels with pronounced sculpted plastic edges and soft contact shadows, bold cobalt headers, lemon-yellow selected navigation, cream-white cards on pale sky. Buttons feel pressable like molded toy pieces with thick bottom lips; pressed state removes the bottom lip. Original toy block mark and little rounded shield/target icons. Dashboard text deep ink. Friendly bold rounded typography, but mature and tidy, no baby styling. BUY dark emerald and SELL berry with readable white labels. Chart pure off-white without decoration. Tiny dimensional blocks only around the title or empty outer board margins.
themes.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exceptionally polished, high-resolution 3840 x 2160 landscape UI KIT PRESENTATION BOARD for the Roblox trading simulator "Get Funded!" aimed at kids and teens. This is a static art-direction preview, not promotional concept art. Use crisp readable typography and practical interface design. All artwork and small icons must be original, no stock icons, trademarks, Roblox logo, watermarks, real trading companies, payment or deposit UI.

MANDATORY BOARD TEMPLATE shared across six separate designs:
Top strip: small "GET FUNDED! / UI EXPLORATIONS", large concept number and NAME, one brief personality line.
Main upper area: LEFT 72% a large flat straight-on desktop trading dashboard (not tilted, no monitor photo). RIGHT 23% a tall, straight-on PORTRAIT MOBILE dashboard inside a subtle phone silhouette. Label these "DESKTOP" and "MOBILE". Under the desktop, a compact palette and typography strip. The bottom third spans the full board and is a well-organized matching COMPONENT LIBRARY arranged in four generous columns. Clean grid, whitespace, nothing cropped. No decorative artwork over the candlestick chart. Do not substitute line charts.

SAME DESKTOP CONTENT AND CORE LAYOUT:
Header: "Get Funded!", persistent small but legible "Simulated market · Virtual funds", small friendly profile icon.
Left vertical navigation: "Trade" selected, "Positions", "Challenges", "Learn". At its bottom a small challenge card: "Practice challenge" / "Use a stop loss" / "2 of 3 complete".
Main top row three account stat cards: "Virtual balance" "$10,000"; "Account value" "$10,075"; "Open result" "↑ Gain +$75".
Main center, 70% width: chart card. Instrument selector "BLOX 100 ▾"; large current price "1,250.00"; "↑ +12.50 (+1.01%)". Timeframe tabs "1m", "5m" selected, "15m", "1h". Clear up/down CANDLESTICK chart on a quiet plain plotting surface with thin neutral grid and readable right-hand prices 1,260 / 1,250 / 1,240 / 1,230 / 1,220; bottom time labels 10:00 / 10:15 / 10:30 / 10:45. Use identical candle pattern: about 28 candles zigzag upward from 1,225 to 1,250, upward candles filled, downward candles hollow to pair shape with color. Tiny legend "Filled ↑ Up" and "Hollow ↓ Down". No confetti, characters, glows, gradients, art, or graphics inside plot.
Main right, 30% width: "Place a trade" order panel. "BLOX 100"; quantity stepper with minus, "1", plus and visible "Quantity" label. Two labeled fields "SL · Stop loss" "1,230.00" and "TP · Take profit" "1,280.00". Tiny helpful explanation "Auto-close prices". Large unambiguous buttons "↑ BUY" and "↓ SELL", each at least 48px equivalent touch height. Both equal visual weight. Clear keyboard-free layout.
Below chart and order panel: "Open positions · 2". Headers Instrument / Side / Qty / Entry / Result / Action. Row 1: "BLOX 100", "BUY", "2", "1,200.00", "↑ Gain +$100", "CLOSE". Row 2: "TECH 50", "BUY", "1", "2,525.00", "↓ Loss −$25", "CLOSE". Add readable compact SL and TP chips as space allows. Gains/losses must have explicit words and arrows, never only color.

SAME MOBILE CONTENT AND ORDER in a real usable portrait design, NOT a shrunk desktop:
Width-equivalent 390px, generous 48px touch targets, essential text 16px equivalent. Header "Get Funded!" and "Simulated market · Virtual funds" always legible. Compact row: "Balance $10,000", "Value $10,075", "↑ Gain +$75". Instrument "BLOX 100 ▾", price "1,250.00". Same timeframe tabs and uncluttered candles. Below chart: labeled Quantity stepper and compact SL 1,230 / TP 1,280 fields. Large side-by-side "↑ BUY" / "↓ SELL" buttons. Compact "Open positions · 2" cards with "BLOX 100 · BUY · 2", "↑ Gain +$100", "CLOSE", and "TECH 50 · BUY · 1", "↓ Loss −$25", "CLOSE". Bottom navigation "Trade" / "Positions" / "Challenges" / "Learn" with friendly original simple icons. No text or buttons smaller just to stuff the screen. Portrait preview may be tall to fit.

BOTTOM COMPONENT LIBRARY (clearly titled groups, consistent with the dashboard style):
Column 1 "ACTIONS + STATES": sample BUY, SELL, CLOSE buttons; five explicitly labeled examples "Default", "Pressed", "Selected", "Disabled", "Error". Show default BUY, physically depressed BUY, selected Trade tab with check or underline, disabled BUY with disabled styling, error quantity field containing "0" and text "Enter at least 1". States must visibly differ beyond color.
Column 2 "NAVIGATION + INPUTS": Trade / Positions / Challenges / Learn tabs with Trade selected; instrument dropdown with "BLOX 100" selected plus visible dropdown options "TECH 50" and "GOLD"; Quantity minus/1/plus control; expanded readable "SL · Stop loss" and "TP · Take profit" chips with original shield/target icons.
Column 3 "CARDS + FEEDBACK": compact Virtual balance $10,000 account card; compact matching position rows, one "↑ Gain +$100" and one "↓ Loss −$25" both with "CLOSE"; success notification "✓ Stop loss saved"; error notification "! Enter at least 1" with helpful plain language.
Column 4 "MODAL DIALOG": open example modal "Close this position?" / "BLOX 100 · BUY · 2" / "Current result: ↑ Gain +$100" / buttons "Keep open" and "CLOSE". Opaque, readable and matching theme. Below modal a smaller error-dialog example: "Check quantity" / "Enter 1 or more to place a trade." / "Got it".

PALETTE + TYPE STRIP: six big color swatches with exact hex labels provided by the theme below. Typeface specimens show "Get Funded! Aa" as headline, "Buy, sell, build your skills." as body, and "1,250.00 +$100 −$25" as aligned numeric text. Label heading/body font families provided by theme.

QUALITY: Keep all content correct and readable, identical facts and layout across concepts, clean spacing, balanced density, crisp edges, restrained decoration. Avoid over-childish mascots, real-money claims, gambling motifs, wealth promises, rewards for risky volume, tiny illegible labels, or text collisions. Make the surface treatment and shape language genuinely distinct.

themes.name: 02 / NEON ARCADE
themes.fonts: Rajdhani bold heading; Inter body and tabular numbers
themes.design: Dark arcade cabinet styling: firm 10px corner panels, electric blue edges, violet raised keys, thin luminous perimeter accents, subtle pixel notches in navigation and an original joystick/candle emblem. Strong tall futuristic letterforms with generous spacing. Crisp opaque midnight chart with subdued grid, NO glow on candles or text inside chart. BUY mint and SELL rose with midnight labels. Active navigation shows a bright cyan left rail and tiny chevron. Pressed buttons appear sunken, selected has bright underline, disabled is dim with a lock icon, errors use an exclamation border. Decorative neon is restricted to panel perimeter, title, and challenge card; polished teen arcade energy not cyberpunk clutter.

Distinct squishy gel/pastel softness, not Toy Box plastic bevels.

Space flourish confined to title and challenge card.
